mainEntity.name: What is Website Entity Optimization for AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Website Entity Optimization for AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) involves structuring your website's content and technical elements to explicitly define key entities (people, places, things, concepts) relevant to your business. This helps search engines and AI-powered answer engines better understand your content's meaning, leading to more accurate and comprehensive answers in search results. It goes beyond traditional keyword optimization by focusing on semantic relationships and data organization, making your site more discoverable for complex queries and voice searches.
acceptedAnswer.description: Website Entity Optimization for AEO structures your site's content to help search engines and AI understand its meaning, improving visibility for complex and voice queries.
